title: Remote Host verification failure

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Failed, unreadable, mismatched, or ambiguous remote verification must clear verified active remote state and must not render the host as a verified active account.
When remote verification detects a different saved account, CodexPill must surface recovery state without replacing the saved account catalog or treating the detected account as verified active.

targetSurface: CodexPill remote host verifier, runtime state, and menu projection

nonClaims: Does not exercise live SSH, live Codex app-server behavior, real remote auth mutation, or a real remote filesystem.
Does not prove native click automation or live menu-bar interaction.
Does not prove remote rate-limit fallback.
Does not prove live macOS menu-bar behavior.
